package tech

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// DeleteTech removes tech by id.
type DeleteTech struct {
	Techs repository.TechRepository
}

// Handle deletes tech.
func (uc DeleteTech) Handle(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	return uc.Techs.Delete(ctx, id)
}
